item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud kyi sgrib sel snang ba dpal gyi chu zla bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun
item.coloph: sngags sgrub kyi skabs su gsal byed chog khrigs bde ba'i yan lag snang ba dpal gyi chu zla bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba/ dmu rgyal nyi ma'i ming chen gyis/ byang gi sa gnas rgyal gyi sa bkod zhes bya ba yi nang du brtsams pa dge legs 'phel/ shing bya zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la bris//
